title: Holding Limits on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
**Clause 1.** A customer may hold several accounts of Savings & Money Market Accounts at Piedmont Crescent Bank.

**Clause 2 — portfolio limit.** The count of the customer's savings accounts whose status is not closed must be below 6 before a new account is opened.

**Clause 3 — tier limit.** The count of the customer's savings accounts of the requested tier whose status is not closed must be below the greatest number of open accounts of that tier one customer may hold, as set for that tier.

**Clause 4 — what counts.** Accounts in applied, active and dormant status count toward both limits. Closed accounts never count toward either.

**Clause 5 — effect.** Reaching either limit declines the opening, and no account record is written.

### Basis of the count

Both counts are taken from the bank's own record of the customer's savings accounts before the opening is made, not from the number of accounts the customer states they hold. The portfolio count is taken across every savings account carried under that customer; the tier count is taken across the savings accounts carried under that customer whose tier is the tier being requested.

### Both limits bind independently

| Portfolio count below 6 | Tier count below the tier's own limit | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the opening proceeds |
| yes | no | the opening is declined, with no account record written |
| no | yes | the opening is declined, with no account record written |
| no | no | the opening is declined, with no account record written |

### Boundary of the portfolio limit

The limit is expressed as below 6, not as at most 6. A customer holding 5 savings accounts that are not closed sits below the figure and the portfolio limit is met; a customer holding 6 does not. A customer holding 7 accounts of which 2 are closed counts 5 toward the limit, since closed accounts never count.
